calibration.note: synthesis reproduces the standard solar Ba II 5853 relation: A(Ba)=2.27 (Asplund) -> ~66 mA, matching Korotin2015/Mashonkina clean-line EW ~64 mA. Confirms the synthesis absolute scale is correct.

Both engines agree Ba II NLTE is small-negative (~-0.02..-0.03), so A(Ba) is insensitive to engine choice (2.41 either way).

blend_caveat: Pool EW 74.62 mA carries blend_flag=True; it is ~10 mA stronger than the clean solar Ba II 5853 (~64 mA), inflating A by ~+0.15. Value is a blend/gf-limited UPPER estimate -> CURATION-OWED; deblend owed (RYA-161/162). Do NOT tune.
